legal_classification.rule: The operational use of the words research, needs analysis, survey, evidence or NF-RUN does not by itself classify AI4WORK processing as scientific research within the meaning of the GDPR. The current PROD design relies on ordinary GDPR lawful-basis, transparency, rights, minimisation, retention and processor controls and claims no special scientific-research compatibility presumption or rights limitation.

edpb_guidance_context.reference: EDPB Guidelines 1/2026 on processing of personal data for scientific research purposes
indicative_factors: potential to contribute to existing scientific knowledge or apply existing knowledge in novel ways
edpb_guidance_context.boundary: The EDPB factors are used as a guard against automatic classification from labels. This control does not itself determine that AI4WORK is or is not scientific research and does not replace controller/legal review.

current_ai4work_control_position.purpose: needs analysis for an AI4WORK STEP project concept and funding application
current_ai4work_control_position.reason: The current minimised design can remain fail-closed under ordinary GDPR rules without relying on scientific-research derogations or compatibility presumptions.

change_control.trigger: Any proposal to rely on scientific-research status for purpose compatibility, broader reuse, storage, transparency, data-subject-rights limitations or another GDPR special rule.
required_before_change: separate legal assessment against the then-current EDPB guidance and applicable Union/Romanian law
documented assessment of the six indicative scientific-research factors against the actual AI4WORK processing
identification of the exact legal provision relied upon rather than a generic citation to Article 89
review of safeguards, Article 13 wording, rights procedure, retention and DPIA impact
immutable approval reference and SHA-256 before any PROD reliance

prohibited_shortcuts: inferring scientific-research status from the repository folder name or the word research
using Article 89 as a generic lawful basis
limiting access, erasure, restriction or objection merely because the activity is called research
extending retention merely because the activity is called research
reusing real respondent data for a materially different purpose under an unapproved scientific-research compatibility claim

test_twin.rule: Synthetic engineering fixtures cannot establish scientific-research status, legal eligibility or empirical need.
